DC_IOSTREAM_CLOSE(3) Library Functions Manual DC_IOSTREAM_CLOSE(3)

NAME

dc_iostream_close — Close the I/O stream and free all resources.

LIBRARY

library “libdivecomputer”

SYNOPSIS

#include <libdivecomputer/iostream.h>

dc_status_t
dc_iostream_close(dc_iostream_t *iostream);

DESCRIPTION

Close the I/O stream and free all resources. Accepts the iostream to close and free.

RETURN VALUES

Returns DC_STATUS_SUCCESS on success, or another dc_status_t code on failure.

SEE ALSO

dc_usbhid_open(3), dc_serial_open(3), dc_irda_open(3), dc_bluetooth_open(3).
